stemMarkdown: A pipe can fill a cistern in 12 hours, while a waste pipe at the bottom can empty the full cistern in 22 hours. If both are opened together, how many hours will the cistern take to fill? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The filling pipe adds $\dfrac{1}{12}$ per hour and the waste pipe removes $\dfrac{1}{22}$ per hour, so the net rate is $\dfrac{1}{12} - \dfrac{1}{22} = 0.037879$ per hour. The cistern fills in $26.4$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: An emptying pipe is simply a negative rate — the arithmetic is otherwise identical.
